purpose: Prepared manager handoff for the actual future host/owner comprehension gate; no participant result or runtime pass.
prerequisites: Current TASK-022 keyboard and VoiceOver/Safari evidence
Exact safe live local URL with bootstrap removed before retained evidence
Selected fixture/root answer key derived from current canonical records and source references
criteria: Participant can attempt find/explain term, distinguish terms, interpret relation endpoints/meaning, visit neighbor/return, understand supported or absent process order and inspect freshness.
Record completion, wrong turns, mistaken meanings, requests for help and participant wording; 30s known-term target stays proposed and no statistical generalization is made.
Resolve high-impact reversed-direction or layout-causality misconceptions before claiming usable release; owner-only results state the limitation.
preparation: Record participant role and whether only the owner is available; do not collect unnecessary personal information.
Record actual hardware, browser, assistive technology, build/source/fixture hashes and tested theme/motion/zoom.
Fill bracketed entry labels and answer keys only from the validated current fixture/root; record duplicate meanings and relation IDs before the session.
Use the same ordinary visible controls a reader has. Do not coach with renderer, schema, API, or internal implementation vocabulary.
Keep credentials and private source bodies out of recordings/screenshots; retain only necessary safe observations.

tasks.prompt: Find [known term]. Explain what it means in your own words.
tasks.observe: Start-to-first-correct-entry and explanation time; wrong turns and requests for help; definition/source fidelity. The 30-second target is proposed, not a pass inferred from automation.

tasks.prompt: These entries share a name. Explain which one matches [source-backed context] and why.
tasks.observe: Identity/module distinction, ambiguity, alias interpretation and unsupported auto-selection.

tasks.prompt: Read this relationship. Explain who or what is related, what the relationship means, and any conditions.
tasks.observe: Canonical subject/predicate/object direction and qualifier understanding; any reversed meaning.

tasks.prompt: Visit a connected entry, then return to where you were reading.
tasks.observe: Navigation completion, retained selection/context, map focus/camera surprise, keyboard alternatives.

tasks.prompt: What does the position of these items tell you? Explore another connection and explain what changed.
tasks.observe: Any layout-as-causality/chronology misconception, selection versus explicit focus and expansion understanding.

tasks.prompt: Explain what this process does and what order, if any, its documentation supports.
tasks.observe: Supported purpose/roles/inputs/outputs; ordered versus unordered/partial evidence; no invented execution sequence.

tasks.prompt: Open the evidence for this statement. Explain whether the displayed source is the recorded version and return to the entry.
tasks.observe: Correct owner/reference selection, source freshness meaning, preserved definition and focus return.

record_each: Wrong turns, requests for help and uncoached participant wording
Incorrect or uncertain meanings and their source
Issue severity and observed correction or outstanding limitation
dispositions: High-impact reversed-relation or layout-causality misunderstandings block usable-release acceptance until the responsible owner fixes them and targeted walkthrough/tests are repeated.
An owner-only walkthrough is a qualified result, not a broader participant study or statistical claim.
Agent/browser automation cannot be reported as human comprehension.
Unperformed participant/platform work remains explicitly incomplete; broad implementation approval is not evidence of a human outcome.
status: protocol prepared; all participant observations unperformed
